# json-peek

Shape of a JSON or JSONL file: keys, row count, one sample. Never the data.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | yes |  | JSON or JSONL file inside the repo |
| `--depth` | int | no | `2` | How deep to walk nested keys |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run json-peek --path <path>
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys kind, keys, rows, sample, truncated.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/json-peek.py --path <path>` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
